subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support `cookie refresh` as an immediate browser-import command, or only as a cache-invalidation request that the signed app completes on its next provider refresh?
rationale: The branch itself records that the CLI is commonly unable to perform the advertised browser import because the required entitlement is tied to the signed app, so implementation quality alone cannot choose the permanent user contract.

options.title: Make immediate refresh signed-app-backed
options.body: Keep the command only if it can hand work to an entitled app path and report a completed provider refresh, with clear failure output when that path is unavailable.

options.title: Scope CLI to cache invalidation
options.body: Retain a clearly named cache-clear/recovery command that never promises immediate import and directs users to the app for the actual browser re-import.

options.title: Limit this change to settings UI
options.body: Keep the entitled settings action and defer the standalone CLI surface until an app-to-CLI recovery mechanism is intentionally designed.

recommendation.title: Make immediate refresh signed-app-backed
recommendation.body: Keep the command only if it can hand work to an entitled app path and report a completed provider refresh, with clear failure output when that path is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice defines a new long-lived CLI and provider-auth recovery contract rather than a mechanical patch detail.
